name: Paul Cézanne

summary.text: Paul Cézanne was a French Post-Impressionist painter whose work introduced new modes of representation, influenced avant-garde artistic movements of the early 20th century and formed the bridge between late 19th-century Impressionism and early 20th-century Cubism.
summary.title: Paul Cézanne

portrait.au: Unknown; Cézanne was born in 1839 and died in 1906

614986: A Modern Olympia is a c. 1873–74 painting by Impressionist painter Paul Cézanne. The painting's title and subject are a homage to Édouard Manet's 1863 painting Olympia.

2270805: The Boy in the Red Vest, also known as The Boy in the Red Waistcoat, is an oil painting by Paul Cézanne, painted in 1888–1890. It is a fine example of Cézanne's skilled, nuanced, and innovative mature work after 1880.

2270938: The Bathers is an oil painting by French artist Paul Cézanne, first exhibited in 1906.

3210778: Mont Sainte-Victoire seen from Bellevue is a landscape painting dating from around 1886, by the French artist Paul Cézanne. The subject of the painting is the Montagne Sainte-Victoire in Provence in southern France.
3399375: Portrait of Ambroise Vollard is an 1899 oil-on-canvas portrait by Paul Cézanne of his art dealer Ambroise Vollard. It was bequeathed by Vollard on his death to the Petit Palais in Paris, where it is still housed today.
3494409: Mont Sainte-Victoire is a series of oil paintings by French artist Paul Cézanne, depicting the French mountain Montagne Sainte-Victoire in Provence.
